GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanFText:
Whew, I'm tired.

I sometimes come
up to the rooftop

to take a break
from shopping.
GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofFisherText:
Pardon? Who says
an adult can't get into this?

I'm going to be
back every day to

collect all the
dolls!
GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTwinText:
They have bargain
sales here every so often.
GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanMText:
There's something
I really want, but

I don't have the
necessary cash…

Maybe I'll sell
off the BERRIES I've collected…
GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTeacherText:
Oh, everything is
so cheap!

I bought so much,
my PACK's crammed!
GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofBugCatcherText:
My #MON always
get paralyzed or

poisoned when the
chips are down…

So I came to buy
some FULL HEAL.

I wonder if
there's any left?
Binoculars1Text:
These binoculars
let me see far

away. Maybe I can
see my own house.

Is it the one with
the green roof?
Binoculars2Text:
Hey! Some trainers
are battling on the road!

A #MON fired a
flurry of leaves!

That makes me feel
like battling right now!
Binoculars3Text:
A FISHER caught a
lot of MAGIKARP…

They're SPLASHing
at the same time!

Look at the water
going everywhere!
PokeDollVendingMachineText:
A vending machine
for #MON dolls?

Insert money, then
turn the crank…

But it's almost
empty…
